Android offline-first field client, IoT device ingestion and a public traceability page follow the SRS milestone order. Persistence layer arrives at M2 without changing the tenant-isolation contract.

decisions.decision: Repository visibility PUBLIC for dungnt-mhy/iaict-core-platform, chosen by the Owner in chat on 2026-11-02. Full SOW/SRS documents are NOT classified for publication: only hashes and public-safe summaries are recorded in this repository.
Backend stack for the first milestones: Python 3.12 + FastAPI modular monolith; Android client and IoT ingestion follow the SRS milestone order.
Requirements baseline is SRS v2.0 (IAICT/SRS-CORE/2026/V2.0) derived from SOW R21. Requirement changes are appended to pcs/SRS_CHANGES.md as deltas; the baseline itself is never edited.

Correction by Owner (2026-11-02): the connected GitHub account is mihynt (verified via get_me, account id 351337042), not dungnt-mhy. Repository target corrected to mihynt/iaict-core-platform. DEC-001 is otherwise unchanged: visibility PUBLIC, full SOW/SRS not published.

Repository created by the Owner as mihynt/iaict-core-platform-muse-dfalse.home (PUBLIC) because the Muse GitHub App lacks repository-creation permission (403). This actual repository is the project's canonical GitHub home; it supersedes the proposed name in DEC-004.

Beta hosting decided by Owner (2026-11-02): Cloudflare Workers Free runs the API and web UI; Neon Free provides PostgreSQL, reached from Workers through Hyperdrive Free; Supabase was evaluated and kept as a fully compatible alternative. Portability rules are binding: (1) only deploy/cloudflare/src/entry.py knows about Cloudflare - no Cloudflare-proprietary APIs (D1/KV/Durable Objects) in core logic; (2) persistence uses standard SQL and widely-available PostgreSQL extensions only, no Neon/Supabase platform extras (their Auth/Storage/Realtime) in the product core; (3) the app stays stateless, all durable state in PostgreSQL; daily development and tests use a local database, Neon is reserved for the shared beta/staging environments (separate Neon project per environment, compute kept at the 0.25 CU minimum). Rationale: the whole beta stack costs 0; PostgreSQL-to-PostgreSQL migration between Neon and Supabase, or out to a VPS/AWS/Azure/GCP running the same ASGI app under uvicorn, stays a pg_dump/pg_restore operation. Deployment packaging prepared in deploy/cloudflare/ with runbook docs/DEPLOY_CLOUDFLARE_NEON.md; actual deployment awaits the Owner's Cloudflare and Neon accounts.

product_map.summary: Multi-tenant SaaS core platform for agriculture-forestry-aquaculture production management: shared Core + Vertical Packs. Baseline scope: 302 functional requirements in 22 groups, 56 NFR, 31 security controls, 11 hardware baselines, 12 compliance rules (CMP-01..12), 115 UAT scenarios, 64 deliverables, 82 minimum reports. Milestones M0-M7 over 240 days; hard day-90 gate M3a; pilot go-live M5; commercial readiness M7.
